name: The Singular Patagonia
insider_take: This remote luxury lodge sits on the shores of Last Hope Sound, where dramatic granite peaks meet pristine waters in one of Earth's most untouched wilderness areas.
whats_special: The Singular Patagonia occupies a restored 1915 Cold Storage Plant, seamlessly blending industrial heritage with contemporary luxury. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking views of the Patagonian fjords, while the hotel's location in Puerto Natales makes it the perfect base for exploring Torres del Paine National Park—just 2 hours away.
pro_tip: Book the Milodon Suite for unobstructed sound views and request dinner reservations early—the hotel's restaurant features locally-sourced Patagonian lamb and king crab from the nearby waters.
dont_miss: The on-site museum showcasing the building's fascinating history as a wool and meat processing plant, and the guided boat excursions to see Patagonian wildlife including sea lions, cormorants, and if you're lucky, dolphins playing in the sound's crystal-clear waters.
pros: Stunning Patagonian landscape views with unique industrial heritage design
Exclusive waterfront location on Última Esperanza Sound
World-class spa and wellness facilities with regional treatments
Exceptional fine dining featuring local Patagonian cuisine
cons: Remote Patagonian location requires significant travel planning
